title: Raw Salmon Oshizushi (Pressed Sushi)
description: Rectangular, lightly compressed sushi rice covered with thin sashimi-style salmon.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Line a small clean rectangular container or oshizushi mold with food-safe wrap, leaving overhang.
Place overlapping chilled raw salmon slices across the bottom, add prepared rice evenly, and lay nori across the back.
Cover and press lightly using a flat surface to keep grains intact. Chill briefly 5–10 minutes to aid cutting.
Invert onto a cutting board, unwrap and divide into eight rectangles with a damp knife. Sprinkle with sesame and optional lemon.
notes: Press without mashing the rice. Use salmon suitable for raw consumption.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
